corrections.finding: Measure dropped: source says larger shoals reliably moved toward shadow; text says only 'a school' with no size or reliability. Also 'leaving as light comes' loses that they sped up and that the light moved onto them; 'ending' softened from tracking collapsing.
corrections.fixed_text: A lone golden shiner fish under moving light and shadow is moving almost at random, each fish slowing only with the darkness at its own place and keeping close to its neighbours; a larger school of them is reliably turning toward shade, slowing and gathering in it and speeding up to leave as light moves onto them, and this orienting is collapsing when a school is smaller than some size, an orienting no fish of the school has.

corrections.finding: Claim stronger than source: 'no average' where the source says not simply the average; 'significantly' dropped from shorter routes; 'homing' added, not in the observing; 'in measure with' blurs proportional to solo-flight fidelity.
corrections.fixed_text: Larger flocks of pigeons are flying significantly shorter routes than smaller flocks, and a flock's route is not simply the average of its birds' routes: each pigeon is leaning the route in proportion to how faithfully it is reproducing its own route when flying alone.

corrections.finding: Measure changed: 'about 0.1 µm' where source says as small as 0.1 µm. Dropped 'transverse' vibrations in the 90-degree leg comparison, and 'greatest radial tension' became 'most pull'. 'struggling insect' added, not in the observing.
corrections.fixed_text: An orb spider at the hub of its web is sensing through the threads with slit organs at its leg joints, movements as small as 0.1 µm; the leg with the greatest tension along its radial thread is giving the direction, and comparing transverse vibrations across legs about 90 degrees apart is giving the distance, the web's lines and the spider's legs one orienting surface.

corrections.finding: Claim stronger and changed: source says the triangle product retains none of the station phases and makes a particular reference unnecessary, while additive noise and baseline-specific errors remain; text drops the remaining errors, says 'cancelling' broadly, swaps 'reference' for 'timing', and adds 'holding the source', which the observing does not give.
corrections.fixed_text: Closure phase is this file's own observing of a web of co-linears: around a triangle of three stations the product of the visibilities retains none of the stations' own phases, so no particular reference is needed, while additive noise and baseline-specific errors remain; a dish array co-competencing by the sequencing of its betweens, and not by a reference each station keeps, is the sensor-sensationing method still-possibling to build.
